"vector_string": null}, "cvss_v4": {"score": null, "vector_string": null}}, "cwe_ids": [], "cwes": [], "description": "### Summary
An authenticated account marked restricted can search and read issues belonging to Limited-visibility users through the issue-search API and web issue-search route. Affected responses include full issue titles and bodies, and keyword searches can surface issue content through matches in titles, bodies or comments. Anonymous issue search correctly returns nothing for the same content.

### Details
The issue-search path does not treat a restricted viewer the way it treats an anonymous viewer for Limited-visibility owners, so issues that should be hidden are returned.

### Impact
Confidentiality only. Disclosure of issue titles, bodies and comment-matched content of Limited-visibility users to a restricted viewer with no organization, collaboration or scope relationship.

### Affected versions
Gitea `<= 1.27.2`.

### Patches
Fixed in Gitea 1.27.3 (#39004, #39039).

### Workarounds
None. Upgrade to 1.27.3.
